title: Hapnin
subtitle: Social Event Discovery Platform
overview: Hapnin is a centralized event discovery platform that helps people easily find, verify, and plan attendance for nearby events with confidence.
problem: People are interested in attending social, cultural, faith-based and educational events, but discovery is frustrating. Information is scattered across social media, WhatsApp, posters, word of mouth and different websites, so there is no single reliable place to see what is happening nearby. This fragmentation makes searching time-consuming and details hard to verify, and people often miss events they would have loved to attend.
solution: A location-based event discovery app that centralizes events into one organized platform with clear, complete details: description, date and time, venue, pricing, attendance requirements and organizer information. By simplifying discovery, the product reduces missed opportunities, improves trust in event information and encourages greater community participation.

sections.title: Product Overview
sections.content:
Hapnin is a centralized event discovery platform that helps people find, verify and plan attendance for nearby events with confidence.

Problem: Event information is scattered across social media, WhatsApp, posters and word of mouth. There is no single trusted place to see what is happening nearby, key details (date, venue, time, pricing, registration, organizer credibility) are inconsistent, and people miss events they would have attended.

Challenges

- Event information is spread across many platforms, making discovery slow
- No single trusted source for events in a user's location
- Difficult to verify accuracy and organizer credibility
- Key details are often missing, unclear or inconsistent

Solution: A location-based app that centralizes events into one organized platform with clear, complete details, so people discover events faster, trust the information and plan ahead with confidence.

sections.title: The Goal
sections.content:
- Centralize nearby social, cultural, faith-based and educational events in one platform
- Reduce the time and effort to discover relevant events
- Standardize details (date, time, venue, cost, registration) for clarity
- Help users verify organizers and event authenticity
- Enable planning with clear timing, location and pricing
- Filter by location, date, category and cost
- Support organizers with a structured way to publish accurate details

sections.title: Our Mission
sections.content: To make discovering local events reliable and stress-free by bringing all events into one trusted, location-based platform, so people plan confidently and never miss events that matter to them.

sections.title: Products
sections.content:
Web landing page: The first release introduces the product, communicates its value, lets early users discover events and sign up for updates, and onboards organizers with minimal friction.

Mobile apps: A phased expansion into mobile brings real-time, location-driven discovery with filtering, saving, notifications and planning, testing core assumptions early before building the richer mobile-first experience.

sections.title: Services
sections.content:
- Ticket selling & buying: Purchase or reserve tickets in-app. Free events allow registration; paid events show clear pricing, availability and confirmation.
- Booking & logistics: Integrations for ride-hailing and nearby hotels help users plan travel and accommodation, especially for events outside their area.
- Location & navigation: Maps and directions help users reach venues on time.
- Reminders & notifications: Alerts before events and updates to time, venue or schedule reduce missed events.

sections.title: What Stands Out
sections.content: Unlike platforms focused on ticketed or niche events, Hapnin is a centralized, location-first platform for local and community-driven gatherings, including free and informal events that are often overlooked. It standardizes event details and highlights organizer credibility, replacing reliance on scattered sources like social media and WhatsApp with a simple, planning-focused experience.

sections.title: Users
sections.content:
Primary

- Young adults and working professionals attending social events, meetups and workshops
- Community and faith-based members attending church, mosque, fellowship and convention programs

Secondary

- Event organizers and community leaders who need a structured, trusted way to publish accurate event information and reach the right audience.

sections.title: Our Competitors
sections.content:
TechLinkUp focuses on tech events such as meetups, hackathons and conferences. Naija.Events lists local entertainment, social and cultural events across Nigeria. Eventbrite is a global ticketing platform for creating, promoting and selling tickets.

What's in it for our users

- One reliable place to find events
- Clear, complete event information
- Confidence and trust in listings
- Time-saving discovery
- Access to a wider range of events

sections.title: Design Thinking: Empathize
sections.content:
Approach: We combined qualitative and quantitative research. Qualitative uncovered the "why" behind motivations and pain points; quantitative measured and validated the findings.

Objectives

- Understand how users currently find events and their pain points around clarity and trust
- Learn how users judge event credibility and decide to attend
- Identify the details that matter most when planning
- Validate assumptions around location-based discovery

Participants: 32 interviewees, 30 quantitative and 2 qualitative (26 young adults, 6 new to a city).

Key insights

- Missed events come from late discovery, not lack of interest, so early visibility matters
- Users rely on WhatsApp, Instagram, flyers and word of mouth, and want one trusted source
- Searching takes 10-30+ minutes, so fast scanning and clarity beat long content
- Unclear venue, time, pricing and registration discourage attendance, so trust is essential
- Free vs paid must be obvious, with pricing visible at a glance
- Users prefer events in their city or state, making location personalization core
- Saved events and reminders are highly valued, supporting planning rather than just discovery

sections.title: Design Thinking: Define
sections.content:
Problem: People miss local events because discovery is fragmented, unclear and unreliable. Details like time, location, cost and organizer credibility are hard to find and verify, leading to missed opportunities and low attendance.

Research, insight, solution

- Research: Users rely on scattered channels, get incomplete information and miss events they wanted to attend.
- Insight: They need one reliable source; early, clear information increases attendance; trust, location relevance and filtering matter; saving and reminders support follow-through.
- Solution: A home feed that prioritizes upcoming events, scannable cards with clear hierarchy and filters, verified organizer profiles, Free/Paid tags, location-based onboarding and save/reminder features.

sections.title: Design Thinking: Ideate
sections.content:
How Might We

- Help users discover relevant events early enough to plan and attend?
- Bring all local event information into one reliable place?
- Make event details clear and scannable at a glance?
- Help users judge whether an event is worth their time and money?
- Surface organizer credibility without overwhelming users?
- Reduce cognitive overload from irrelevant events?
- Help users remember and never miss events they care about?
- Help organizers publish clear, trustworthy information and reach the right audience?

Directions

- Show upcoming events by default, using scannable cards with key info upfront
- Provide strong filters (date, location, category, price) and keyword search
- Highlight date, time, price and distance, with Free/Online/This Weekend tags
- Require pricing to be marked and show exact start and end times
- Ask for location and interests during onboarding and default the feed to the user's city
- Let users save events, sync to calendar and receive reminders
- Offer organizers a guided creation form with required fields and a publish preview
- Match events by location and interests, and let organizers select relevant categories
